text: As a carrier, I need destination and weight, but I should not see the exporter pricing or private contacts.
As a customs broker, I want to see the source passage for each code suggestion before I confirm it.
As a shipper, I want uncertain suggestions to wait for a reviewer. Confidence alone should not submit anything.
As an auditor, I need to know who rejected a recommendation and why the record was changed.
As a platform operator, I want to replace a model only after we test whether the new one still meets requirements.
As a driver, I should be able to flag that a document is wrong without being able to approve customs decisions.
As a shipper, I need my shipment records to remain invisible to other customers.
As a reviewer, I need the system to stop answering when it cannot retrieve a supporting source.
As a freight forwarder, I want inconsistencies in package counts and weights to be explained before dispatch.
As a data protection officer, I want data-sharing permissions to expire and unexpected recipients to be denied.
As a small exporter, I want an offline option, with clear limits, if our external service is unavailable.
As a regulator, I need evidence provenance and a recorded human decision, not a fluent explanation alone.
